answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 161476 Country: india Title: Once the Ishraq time starts, is it permissible to pray Chasht salah after Ishraq salah? Question: Once the Ishraq time starts, is it permissible to pray Chasht salah after Ishraq salah? Answer ID: 161476 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 965/774/B=8/1439) Yes, it is lawful. The timing of both the salah is same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
